text:
amanda: deploybot just kicked off v2 canary (eu). mobile prober surfaced a schema mismatch for Lite SDK v1.4.x, 422 on streaming init.
deploy-bot: Rollout started: v2 -> eu (10% traffic). Warnings: client-prober schema-check failed on ~0.8% of requests.
raj: pause. put eu mobile routes on pinlist until we confirm nonbreaking.
leo: +1 to pausing. want to know if this is a header negotiation issue or payload schema change.
sasha: quick check - the logs show missing "session_metadata" in some streaming init payloads. seems like v2 now requires it in a nested place the Lite SDK didn't send.
marta: if it's just nested field optionality we can add a gateway shim to accept missing session_metadata for legacy clients. low-risk hotfix.
jen: I'll start a release-notes note: "Known: Lite SDK v1.4.x may need patch; recommend mobile teams pin to v1 or update to SDK 1.5.0." will mark docs as "do-not-promote" until we confirm.
ops-sre: Suggest: pause canary, add pin for tenant-level mobile routes in EU, kick off gateway shim rollout to gateway-canary group, run quick e2e against mobile-prober. If shim passes, unpause.
raj: timeline? we need this within the 1h change window.
sasha: I can open the shim PR now. small header-negotiation patch to accept either top-level session_metadata or legacy flat field.
amanda: can we do a shorter mitigation: add a tolerant parser in the serving runtime config for v2 that treats missing nested key as null? less infra change.
ops-sre: runtime change touches many pods; gateway shim is lighter and can be scoped to eu-gateway only. prefer gateway shim first.
leo: also need client-side telemetry so we can see exact client versions hitting it. can we tag by user-agent?
sasha: yes, mobile prober includes client-version header. ops-sre, can you enable extra logging for 30m on canary?
ops-sre: enabling prober debug logs for eu canary now.
deploy-bot: Action: added pin: route=mobile-eu, reason="lite-sdk v1.4.x compatibility" by raj at 6412345692. Canary traffic to mobile-eu reduced to 0%.
raj: thanks. next step: sasha PR -> review -> gateway canary deploy. jen keep release notes flagged.
sasha: PR opened: gateway/shims/accept-legacy-session_meta. link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/gateway/pulls/3456
leo: can someone run mobile e2e with SDK 1.4.3 against gateway-canary after deploy? I'll coordinate with mobile QA.
marta: if gateway shim is green we can unpin with a small rollout (5% -> 20% -> 50%). ops-sre to monitor latency/500s.
jen: release notes draft updated and pinned. adding in rollback instructions and the pin stake.
amanda: decision: pause canary for mobile-eu, pin mobile-eu routes, deploy gateway shim to eu-canary, run mobile-prober + QA, then unpause gradually if green.
deploy-bot: Canary paused for route=mobile-eu at 6412345710. Pin confirmed.
ops-sre: I'll own the monitor dashboard and will post a short status update in 20m.
raj: thanks team. once we have green e2e, we'll re-evaluate and publish a short postmortem note for release notes.jen: will prepare a customer-facing blurb if needed. :thumbsup:
